resources.string: To run games from a folder of your choice, OpenJKDF2 needs the \"All files access\" permission. It is only used to read the game files and to write saves and settings in the folders you pick.
Pick a folder on the device storage or SD card.
This folder doesn\'t contain Jedi Knight (Episode/JK1.GOB and Resource/JK_.CD).
This folder doesn\'t contain Mysteries of the Sith (Episode/JKM.GOO and Resource/JK_.CD).
